description: Create an agent and start its first turn. The daemon answers with create_agent_response as soon as the request is accepted, before any event of the turn; the turn's outcome arrives as agent_stream rows and one agent_update (idle or error). Optional fields not shown: env, workspaceId, worktreeName, clientMessageId, outputSchema, images, attachments, autoArchive, labels. Without initialPrompt the agent is a draft and the answer means it exists (status idle). A refusal is an rpc_error and nothing was created. The provider id and cwd shown are the dev daemon's; use your own.
